reserveReview.rationale: KPMG's examination report for May 29, 2026 reports 467,075 PAXG redeemable tokens and 467,075 fine troy ounces of London Good Delivery gold, with no timing differences, temporary differences, surplus, or deficit. Exhibit B identifies London Good Delivery gold as the only redemption asset type. Paxos states that each token represents ownership of an allocated fine troy ounce, and its allocation tool exposes the serial number, brand code, gross weight, fineness, and fine weight of the bars assigned to a holder.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of PAXG redemption assets and redeemable tokens as of May 29, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve asset type is independently examined as allocated London Good Delivery gold. The report names Brink's Global Services Ltd. and ICBC Standard Bank as the LBMA-approved vault providers but does not disclose the ounces held with each provider.
